_comment: Floors for the CI gate. Two agent/v2 runs on PR #4 scored 80.3% and 82.6%; unchanged setups have since produced 8, 11 and 13 regressions against the baseline from noise alone, and a deliberately worse prompt produced 26 (PR #12), so the regression limit is 18. The rate floors sit about twice the noise below the lower run. See evals/README.md.
